name: Occupied Cooling Setpoint
descr: If the control temperature rises one deadband above this setpoint, the control activates the cooling demand. This setpoint does not determine the mode in Occupied operation if the unit is configured for Supply Air Cooling or Supply Air Temp
noteRaw: If the control temperature rises one deadband above this setpoint, the control activates the cooling demand. This setpoint does not determine the mode in Occupied operation if the unit is configured for Supply Air Cooling or Supply Air Temp

name: Occupied Heating Setpoint
descr: If the control temperature drops one deadband below this setpoint, the control activates the heating demand. This setpoint does not determine the mode in Occupied operation if the unit is configured for Supply Air Cooling or Supply Air Temp
noteRaw: If the control temperature drops one deadband below this setpoint, the control activates the heating demand. This setpoint does not determine the mode in Occupied operation if the unit is configured for Supply Air Cooling or Supply Air Temp

name: Hood On Cooling Setpoint

noteRaw: This is the Cooling Mode Enable Setpoint used only in Hood On Mode or Space Temperature Control of High Percentage Outdoor Air Units or VAV Tempering

name: Hood On Heating Setpoint

noteRaw: This is the Heating Mode Enable Setpoint used only in Hood On Mode or Space Temperature Control of High Percentage Outdoor Air Units or VAV Tempering

name: Unoccupied Cooling Offset
descr: During the Unoccupied Mode of Operation, this Setpoint offsets the Occupied Cooling Setpoint up by this user- adjustable amount. Use the default setting of 30°F for this setpoint to prevent Cooling during the Unoccupied Mode.
noteRaw: During the Unoccupied Mode of Operation, this Setpoint offsets the Occupied Cooling Setpoint up by this user- adjustable amount. Use the default setting of 30°F for this setpoint to prevent Cooling during the Unoccupied Mode.

name: Unoccupied Heating Offset
descr: During the Unoccupied Mode of Operation, this Setpoint offsets the Occupied Heating Setpoint down by this user- adjustable amount. Use the default setting of 30°F for this setpoint to prevent Heating during Unoccupied Mode.
noteRaw: During the Unoccupied Mode of Operation, this Setpoint offsets the Occupied Heating Setpoint down by this user- adjustable amount. Use the default setting of 30°F for this setpoint to prevent Heating during Unoccupied Mode.

name: Mode Select Deadband
descr: This value is added to and subtracted from the HVAC Mode Setpoints to create a control deadband range
noteRaw: This value is added to and subtracted from the HVAC Mode Setpoints to create a control deadband range

name: Max Coil Setpoint Reset Limit
descr: This is the highest that the Coil Temperature resets to during Space Humidity Reset of the Coil Suction Temperature Setpoint. If no coil temperature reset is required, this value should be set the same as the Min Coil Reset Limit.
noteRaw: This is the highest that the Coil Temperature resets to during Space Humidity Reset of the Coil Suction Temperature Setpoint. If no coil temperature reset is required, this value should be set the same as the Min Coil Reset Limit.

name: Min Coil Setpoint Reset Limit
descr: This is the lowest the Coil Temperature resets to during Space Humidity Reset of the Coil Suction Temperature Setpoint. If no coil temperature reset is required, this value should be set the same as the Max Coil Reset Limit.
noteRaw: This is the lowest the Coil Temperature resets to during Space Humidity Reset of the Coil Suction Temperature Setpoint. If no coil temperature reset is required, this value should be set the same as the Max Coil Reset Limit.

name: Supply Air Cooling Setpoint

noteRaw: Supply Air Cooling Setpoint. If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the Low SAT Cooling Reset Value

name: Supply Air Heating Setpoint
descr: Supply Air Heating Setpoint. If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the Low SAT Heating Reset Value
noteRaw: Supply Air Heating Setpoint. If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the Low SAT Heating Reset Value

name: Max SAT Cooling Setpoint Reset Limit
descr: If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the High SAT Cooling Reset Value
noteRaw: If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the High SAT Cooling Reset Value

name: Max SAT Heating Setpoint Reset Limit
descr: If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the High SAT Heating Reset Value
noteRaw: If Supply Air Reset is configured this is the High SAT Heating Reset Value

name: Supply Air Cooling Staging Window
descr: In Cooling Mode, if the Supply Air Temperature drops below the Active Supply Air Cooling Setpoint minus this Staging Window, the Cooling Stage deactivates after its Minimum Run Time
noteRaw: In Cooling Mode, if the Supply Air Temperature drops below the Active Supply Air Cooling Setpoint minus this Staging Window, the Cooling Stage deactivates after its Minimum Run Time

name: Supply Air Heating Staging Window
descr: In Heating Mode, if the Supply Air Temperature rises above the Active Supply Air Heating Setpoint plus this Staging Window, the Heating Stage deactivates after its Minimum Run Time
noteRaw: In Heating Mode, if the Supply Air Temperature rises above the Active Supply Air Heating Setpoint plus this Staging Window, the Heating Stage deactivates after its Minimum Run Time

name: Warm-Up Target Temperature (See AV: 89 for Cool-Down Target Temperature)
descr: If Morning Warm-Up is configured, then upon entering occupied mode, the Warm-Up Mode activates if the Return Air is below this temperature by one degree
noteRaw: If Morning Warm-Up is configured, then upon entering occupied mode, the Warm-Up Mode activates if the Return Air is below this temperature by one degree

name: Warm-Up Mode Supply Air Setpoint
descr: During Morning Warm-Up, the Supply Air Temperature is controlled to this Setpoint
noteRaw: During Morning Warm-Up, the Supply Air Temperature is controlled to this Setpoint

name: Cool-Down Mode Supply Air Setpoint
descr: During Morning Cool-Down, the Supply Air Temperature is controlled to this Setpoint
noteRaw: During Morning Cool-Down, the Supply Air Temperature is controlled to this Setpoint

name: Mechanical Cooling Outdoor Air Lockout
descr: Mechanical Cooling is locked out when the Outdoor Air Temperature is below this Setpoint
noteRaw: Mechanical Cooling is locked out when the Outdoor Air Temperature is below this Setpoint

name: Mechanical Heating Outdoor Air Lockout
descr: Mechanical Heating is locked out when the Outdoor Air Temperature is above this Setpoint
noteRaw: Mechanical Heating is locked out when the Outdoor Air Temperature is above this Setpoint

name: Low Supply Temp Cutoff Alarm
descr: Cooling is disabled if the Supply Air Temperature falls below this value. See sequence for more details
noteRaw: Cooling is disabled if the Supply Air Temperature falls below this value. See sequence for more details

name: High Supply Temp Cutoff Alarm
descr: Heating is disabled if the Supply Air Temperature rises above this value. See sequence for more details
noteRaw: Heating is disabled if the Supply Air Temperature rises above this value. See sequence for more details

name: Preheater Cooling Mode Setpoint
descr: If the Preheater is enabled, and the unit is in the Cooling Mode, this is sent to the Preheat-X Controller to control Leaving Air Temperature
noteRaw: If the Preheater is enabled, and the unit is in the Cooling Mode, this is sent to the Preheat-X Controller to control Leaving Air Temperature

name: Preheater Venting Mode Setpoint
descr: If the Preheater is enabled, and the unit is in the Vent Mode, this setpoint is sent to the Preheat-X Controller to control Leaving Air Temperature
noteRaw: If the Preheater is enabled, and the unit is in the Vent Mode, this setpoint is sent to the Preheat-X Controller to control Leaving Air Temperature

name: Preheater Heating Mode Setpoint
descr: If the Preheater is enabled, and the unit is in the Heating Mode, this setpoint is sent to the Preheat-X Controller to control Leaving Air Temperature
noteRaw: If the Preheater is enabled, and the unit is in the Heating Mode, this setpoint is sent to the Preheat-X Controller to control Leaving Air Temperature

name: Outdoor Air Dewpoint Setpoint
descr: On an MUA unit, if the OA dewpoint rises above this setpoint, Dehumidification is initiated
noteRaw: On an MUA unit, if the OA dewpoint rises above this setpoint, Dehumidification is initiated

name: Economizer Enable Setpoint
descr: The economizer is enabled if the outdoor drybulb, dewpoint, or wetbulb temperature falls below this setpoint
noteRaw: The economizer is enabled if the outdoor drybulb, dewpoint, or wetbulb temperature falls below this setpoint

name: Heat Wheel Defrost Enable Setpoint
descr: The unit goes into Heat Wheel Defrost if the Outdoor Air is below this setpoint
noteRaw: The unit goes into Heat Wheel Defrost if the Outdoor Air is below this setpoint

name: PreHeat Enable Setpoint
descr: If the Supply Fan is energized, this is the temperature at which the Preheat Relay activates, or the Preheat-X activates. Operates only in the Occupied Mode.
noteRaw: If the Supply Fan is energized, this is the temperature at which the Preheat Relay activates, or the Preheat-X activates. Operates only in the Occupied Mode.

name: Sensor Slide Offset Max Effect
descr: If the space sensor has the optional slide adjustment feature, this is the maximum amount the slide can adjust the current heating and cooling setpoints up or down with full deflection of the slide
noteRaw: If the space sensor has the optional slide adjustment feature, this is the maximum amount the slide can adjust the current heating and cooling setpoints up or down with full deflection of the slide

name: Space Sensor Calibration Offset
descr: If the Space Temperature Sensor is reading incorrectly, use this option to enter an offset temperature to adjust the Sensor’s Temperature
noteRaw: If the Space Temperature Sensor is reading incorrectly, use this option to enter an offset temperature to adjust the Sensor’s Temperature

descr: This allows the BAS system to input a zone temperature value to the control on a CV/SZVAV unit with communicated zone control (°F).

name: Zone Temp
descr: Zone temperature the control is controlling to (°F).

name: Duct Static Setpoint
descr: A derived value the duct static is controlled to ("W.C.)

name: Active Minimum Air Flow
descr: A derived value the minimum ventilation air is controlled to (CFM).

name: Active Minimum Position
descr: A derived value the damper is controlled to for minimum ventilation air (%).

name: Supply Air Setp
descr: A derived value the supply air temperature is controlled to (°F).

name: Active Slab Control
descr: Allows the active slab control feature to be turned on and off on flexsys units (0 = off / 1 = on).

name: CO Offset 2
descr: The difference between the indoor and outside CO must exceed this value to 2 initiate demand ventilation (PPM).

name: Cooling/Heating Fault
descr: Gives the fault status of the cooling and heating system (NFL - no fault; FLT - faulted).

name: Compressor LPCO 1
descr: Status of compressor system 1 low pressure cutout circuit (0 - faulted / 1 - no fault).

name: Compressor LPCO 2
descr: Status of compressor system 2 low pressure cutout circuit (0 - faulted / 1 - no fault).

name: Compressor LPCO 3 (70- 150 Ton Only)
descr: Status of compressor system 3 low pressure cutout circuit (0 - faulted / 1 - no fault).

name: Compressor Status 1
descr: Status of compressor system 1 compressor safety circuit (0 - faulted / 1 - no fault).

name: Compressor Status 2
descr: Status of compressor system 2 compressor safety circuit (0 - faulted / 1 - no fault).

name: Compressor Status 3 (70- 150 Ton Only)
descr: Status of compressor system 3 compressor safety circuit (0 - faulted / 1 - no fault).

name: Duct Static Pres RST
descr: A hardwired entered analog voltage that results in a %reset down from the duct static high limit based on a percent of the difference between duct static high limit and duct static low limit (%).

name: Duct Static Pres
descr: Actual duct static pressure input to the control ("W.C.)

name: Dew Point Reset
descr: This allows the dew point reset feature to be turned on and off on flexsys units (0 = off / 1 = on).

name: Duct Static Pres RST BAS
descr: A BAS entered value that results in a %reset down from the duct static high limit based on a percent of the difference between duct static high limit and duct static low limit (%). “Duct pres RST BAS” must be enabled using the service key in order to use this feature.

name: Economizer Installed
descr: Allows the economizer feature to be turned on and off (0 = off / 1 = on).

name: Economizer Method
descr: The economizer method being used by the control (o - dry bulb; 1 - single enthalpy; 2 - dual enthalpy).

name: Economizer Suitable Econ Installed
descr: Status of the economizer option (0 - installed and inactive; 1 - installed and active; 2 - not installed).

name: Evap Leaving Air Temp High
descr: On a flexsys unit with bypass this is the supply air temperature high setpoint (°F).

name: Evap Leaving Air Temp Low
descr: On a flexsys unit with bypass this is the supply air temperature low setpoint (°F).

name: Evaporator Air Temp 1
descr: Actual temperature of air leaving the evaporator coil on a flexsys unit (°F).

name: Exhaust Fan
descr: The status of the binary output for the exhaust ( 0 = off / 1 = on).

name: Exhaust Fan Status
descr: The status of the exhaust fan run verification circuit (0 - verification circuit open / 1 - verification circuit closed).

name: Exhaust Output
descr: Control output to the exhaust damper (%).

name: Fan Fault
descr: Identifies if there is a supply, exhaust, or return fan fault (0 - no fault; 1 - faulted).

name: Filter Status
descr: Identifies the status of the binary dirty filter input ( 0 - no fault;1 - faulted).

name: Heat Entering Temp
descr: Actual temperature of the air entering the staged heat section (°F).

name: Heating Sat
descr: The heating sat setpoint for a vav or flexsys unit (°F).

name: Electric Heat Stages Gas Heat Stages
descr: Derived value showing the number of electric or staged gas heat stages available (1 - 7).

name: Heating Valve
descr: The output from the control to a hot water, steam, or modulating gas heat valve (%).

name: Hot Water Frz Status
descr: The status of the freezestat circuit on units with hot water or steam heat. (0 - No fault / 1 - faulted).

name: Maximum Bypass
descr: The maximum allowable setting for the by pass damper in a flexsys unit (%).

name: Max Flow Demand Ventilation
descr: The maximum allowable airflow for demand ventilation with an air measuring station (CFM).

name: Mech Clg Lockout Temp
descr: The minimum outdoor temperature at which mechanical cooling is allowed to operate (°F).

name: Min Flow Demand Ventilation
descr: The minimum allowable airflow for demand ventilation with an air measuring station (CFM).

name: Mixed Sat Limit
descr: On a flexsys unit this is the supply air setpoint when operating without a bypass damper (°F).

name: Morning Warm Up Cmnd
descr: A BAS generated command to allow the morning warm up feature to be turned on and off (0 = off / 1 = on).

name: Rat Heating Setp
descr: On a vav or flexsys unit this is the return air temperature setpoint used to determine when the unit should switch to the heating mode (°F).

name: Night Set Back (For Heating)
descr: This command allows the night set back heating function to be turned on and off (0 = off / 1 = on).

name: OA Damper
descr: This is the position of the outdoor damper (%).

name: OA Damper Min Position 1
descr: The minimum position for the outdoor air damper when using fixed ventilation control when the supply fan is at full speed (%).

name: OA Damper Min Position 2
descr: The minimum position for the outdoor air damper when using fixed ventilation control when the supply fan is at 50% of full speed (%).

name: Outside Air Enthalpy Setpoint
descr: The upper enthalpy limit to allow the use of outdoor air for single or dual enthalpy economizer (btu/lb).

name: Occupancy Command
descr: This BAS command allows the unit to be placed in the occupied or unoccupied mode (0 = unoccupied / 1 = occupied).

name: Rat Cooling Setp
descr: On a vav or flexsys unit this value is used to determine when the unit should switch to the cooling mode (°F).

name: Active Bypass Active Sp
descr: A derived value for the current setpoint of the return air bypass damper on a flexsys unit (%).

name: Exhaust/Return Fan VFD
descr: The output from the control to the exhaust or return fan VFD (%).

name: Return Fan Pressure
descr: The actual pressure that is used to control the return fan ("W.C.).

name: Return Fan Status
descr: The status of the return fan run verification circuit ( 0 - stop - verification circuit open / 1 - verification circuit closed).

name: Sat High Limit
descr: The upper limit for the supply air temperature setpoint on a vav unit (°F).

name: Sat Low Limit
descr: The lower limit for the supply air temperature setpoint on a vav unit (°F).

name: Supply Air Temp RST BAS
descr: This is an analog input from the BAS system that allows the reset of the active supply air temperature setpoint on vav units. 0 Volts uses sat high limit and 5 volts uses sat low limit (v). “Sat RST BAS” must be enabled using the service key in order to use this feature.

name: Saturated Suction Temp (Temperatures 1 Suction)
descr: The saturation temperature of the system 1 suction gas based on the system 1 suction pressure (°F).

name: Saturated Suction Temp (Temperatures 2 Suction)
descr: The saturation temperature of the system 2 suction gas based on the system 2 suction pressure (°F).

name: Saturated Suction Temp (Temperatures 3 Suction) (70- 150 Ton Only)
descr: The saturation temperature of the system 3 suction gas based on the system 3 suction pressure (°F).

name: Sensor/Misc Fault
descr: Identifies if a sensor or miscellaneous fault is present (0 - no fault; 1 - faulted).

name: Sf Proving Switch
descr: The status of the supply fan air proving circuit (0 - verification circuit open / 1 - verification circuit closed).

name: Stg 1 Cooling
descr: For a constant volume unit this is the active sat setpoint for a fiRST stage cooling demand (°F).

name: Stg 1 Heating
descr: For a constant volume unit this is the active sat setpoint for a fiRST stage heating demand (°F).

name: Stg 2 Cooling
descr: For a constant volume unit this is the active sat setpoint for a second stage cooling demand (°F).

name: Stg 2 Heating
descr: For a constant volume unit this is the active sat setpoint for a second stage heating demand (°F).

name: Supply Air Temp RST
descr: This is either a hardwired or communicated 0 to 5vdc input that adjust the supply air setpoint between the sat low and sat high limit (v).

name: Supply Fan VFD
descr: The actual output to the supply fan VFD (%).

name: Supply Fan
descr: The status of the binary output from the controller to the supply fan circuit (0 = off, 1 = on).

name: System Stop
descr: A 0 - value allows all compressors to operate: 1 - Turns off compressor system 1. 2 - Turns off compressor system 2. 3 - Turns off compressor system 3.

name: Temperature 1 Suction
descr: The actual temperature of the system 1 suction line (°F).

name: Temperature 2 Suction
descr: The actual temperature of the system 2 suction line (°F).

name: Temperature 3 Suction (70-150 Ton Only)
descr: The actual temperature of the system 3 suction line (°F).

name: Under Floor Dew Point
descr: The calculated dew point of the air under the floor in a flexsys system (°F).

name: Under Floor Humidity BAS
descr: This allows the BAS system to input a under floor humidity value to the control on a flexsys system (%). “Under flr humi BAS” must be enabled using the service key in order to use this feature.

name: Under Floor Humidity
descr: Humidity value of the air under the floor the control is controlling to in a flexsys system (%).

name: Under Floor Temp BAS
descr: This allows the BAS system to input a under floor temperature value to the control on a flexsys system (°F). “Under flr temp BAS” must be enabled using the service key in order to use this feature.

name: Under Floor Temp
descr: Temperature of the air under the floor the control is controlling to in a flexsys system (°F).

name: Unit Mode
descr: 0 - Occupied cooling 1 - Occupied cooling low 2 - Occupied cooling high 3 - Occupied cooling with bypass 4 - Occupied cooling without bypass 5 - Occupied heating 6 - Occupied heating low 7 - Occupied heating high 8 - Occupied standby 9 - Unoccupied cooling 10 - Unoccupied cooling low 11 - Unoccupied cooling high 12 - Unoccupied heating 13 - Unoccupied heating low 14 - Unoccupied heating high 15 - Unoccupied standby 16 - Comfort vent cooling 17 - Comfort vent heating 18 - Night set back 19 - Morning warm up 20 - Power up standby

name: Unit Stop
descr: This command allows the unit to be shut down through the BAS system (0 = normal operation/ 1 = stopped.

name: Ventilation Demand P1 Outp
descr: The ventilation output being generated by the demand ventilation feature (%).

name: Ventilation Enable
descr: This command allows the ventilation function to be turned on or off (0 = off / 1 = on).

name: Zone Temp BAS
descr: This allows the BAS system to input a zone temperature value (°F) to the control. To use this feature the “control method” must be set to “comm zone temp.”

name: Zone Temp
descr: Zone temperature the control is controlling to (°F).

descr: CV or VAV: DISPLAYS ACTIVE SUPPLY AIR TEMP SP FLEXSYS: IF CURRENT MODE IS OCC COOLING W/O BYPASS, THIS WILL BE = TO MX SAT SP (MIXD SAT LIM; AV14): IF CURRENT MODE IS OCC COOLING W/ BYPASS, THIS WILL BE = TO EITHER EVAP LEAVING HIGH SP (EL AIR TMP H; AV07) OR EVAP LEAVING LOW SP (EL AIR TMP L; AV08) DEPENDING ON SYSTEM CONDITIONS.

descr: ALLOWS DEW POINT RESET FEATURE TO BE TURNED ON/OFF: 0=OFF 1=ON

name: EVAP LEAVING AIR TEMP HIGH SP (FLEXSYS)
descr: DISPLAYS ACTIVE SP FOR HIGH EVAP LEAVING AIR TEMP. THIS IS THE SP THE COMPRESSORS ARE CONTROLLED TO (OCC COOLING W/ BYPASS)

name: EVAP LEAVING AIR TEMP LOW SP (FLEXSYS)
descr: DISPLAYS ACTIVE SP FOR LOW EVAP LEAVING AIR TEMP. THIS IS THE SP THE COMPRESSORS ARE CONTROLLED TO (OCC COOLING W/ BYPASS)

descr: DISPLAYS ACTUAL TEMP OF AIR LEAVING EVAPORATOR (OCC COOLING W/ BYPASS)

name: MX SUPPLY AIR TEMP SP (FLEXSYS)
descr: DISPLAYS THE ACTIVE MIXED AIR TEMP SP (OCC COOLING W/O BYPASS- COMPRESSOR CONTROL) or (OCC COOLING W/ BYPASS-DAMPER CONTROL

name: RETURN AIR DIFF SP BAS (FLEXSYS)
descr: DISPLAYS THE ACTIVE DIFFERENTIAL SP BETWEEN THE RAT AND THE MX SAT SP WHICH IS UTILIZED IN THE INTERNAL LOGIC FOR SELECTING THE PROPER FLEXSYS COOLING MODE; OCC COOLING W/ BYPASS or OCC COOLING W/O BYPASS

name: RESET ENTHALPY SP BAS (FLEXSYS)
descr: DISPLAYS RA ENTHALPY SP THAT CAUSES UNIT TO SWITCH FROM EVAP LEAVING HIGH SP TO EVAP LEAVING LOW SP

descr: CV or VAV: DISPLAYS ACTUAL TEMP OF SUPPLY AIR (°F) FLEXSYS: DISPLAYS ACTUAL TEMP OF MX SUPPLY AIR TEMP (°F)

name: UNDERFLOOR SLAB DEW POINT (FLEXSYS)
descr: DISPLAYS CALCULATED DEW POINT OF UNDERFLOOR AIR (°F)

name: UNDERFLOOR AIR HUMIDITY (FLEXSYS)
descr: DISPLAYS HUMIDITY VALUE OF UNDERFLOOR AIR (% RH)

name: UNDERFLOOR AIR HUMIDITY BAS (FLEXSYS)
descr: ALLOWS THE BAS TO INPUT AN UNDERFLOOR AIR HUMIDITY VALUE TO THE CONTROL. (% RH) "UNDER FLR HUMI BAS" MUST BE ENABLED IN THE SERVICE MENU FOR THIS POINT TO FUNCTION

name: UNDERFLOOR SLAB TEMP BAS (FLEXSYS)
descr: ALLOWS BAS TO INPUT AN UNDERFLOOR SLAB TEMP VALUE TO THE CONTROL (°F) "UNDER FLR TEMP BAS" MUST BE ENABLED IN SERVICE MENU FOR THIS POINT TO FUNCTION

name: ACTIVE MINIMUM POSITION

name: ACTIVE SUPPLY AIR TEMP SP
descr: CV or VAV: DISPLAYS THE ACTIVE SUPPLY AIR TEMP SP FLEXSYS: IF CURRENT MODE IS OCC COOLING W/O BYPASS, THIS WILL BE = TO THE MX SAT SP (MIXD SAT LIM; AV14): IF CURRENT MODE IS OCC COOLING W/ BYPASS, THIS WILL BE = TO EITHER THE EVAP LEAVING HIGH SP (EL AIR TMP H; AV07) OR THE EVAP LEAVING LOW SP (EL AIR TMP L; AV08) DEPENDING ON THE SYSTEM CONDITIONS.

name: ACTIVE SLAB CONTROL (FLEXSYS ONLY)
descr: ALLOWS THE ACTIVE SLAB CONTROL TO BE TURNED ON/OFF 0=OFF 1=ON

name: BLDG PRESS SP

name: CO2 LEVEL OF THE INSIDE AIR
descr: DISPLAYS THE ACTUAL RA AIR CO2 (PPM)

descr: A BAS ENTERED VALUE FOR THE INSIDE CO2 LEVEL. "CO2 LVL INSIDE BAS" MUST BE ENABLED USING THE SERVICE KEY IN ORDER TO USE THIS POINT

name: CO2 OFFSET SP
descr: DISPLAYS THE VALUE (PPM) THAT THE INDOOR CO2 MUST RISE ABOVE THE OUTSIDE CO2 TO ACTIVATE DEMAND VENTILATION

descr: DISPLAYS THE OPERATING HRS OF COMP 3A

name: COMP 3B OPERATING HRS (70-150 TON ONLY)
descr: DISPLAYS THE OPERATING HRS OF COMP 3B

descr: DISPLAYS THE STATUS OF THE LOW PRESS SWITCH ON CKT 1: 0=Normal (OKAY) 1=Fault(ed)

name: SAFETY INPUT LPCO CKT 2 STATUS
descr: DISPLAYS THE STATUS OF THE LOW PRESS SWITCH ON CKT 2: 0=Normal (OKAY) 1=Fault(ed)

name: SAFETY INPUT LPCO CKT 3 STATUS (70-150 TON ONLY)

descr: DISPLAYS THE STATUS OF CKT 2 SAFETY CHAIN: 0=Normal (OKAY) 1=Fault(ed)

descr: NOT USED AT THIS TIME. FOR FUTURE USE

descr: DISPLAYS THE ACTUAL TEMP OF THE AIR LEAVING THE EVAPORATOR (OCC COOLING W/ BYPASS)

name: ELECT HEAT STAGE 5 STATUS STAGED GAS FURN 3 LOW STATUS MOD GAS FURN 3 LOW STATUS
descr: DISPLAYS THE STATUS OF THE CONTROL OUTPUT TO THE INDICATED HEAT SECTION: 0=OFF 1=ON

name: ELECT HEAT STAGE 6 STATUS STAGED GAS FURN 3 HIGH STATUS MOD GAS FURN 3 HIGH STATUS
descr: DISPLAYS THE STATUS OF THE CONTROL OUTPUT TO THE INDICATED HEAT SECTION: 0=OFF 1=ON

descr: DISPLAYS THE STATUS OF THE CONTROL OUTPUT TO THE INDICATED HEAT SECTION: 0=OFF 1=ON
